relations.text: 2026年6月にFedExからスピンオフ。受注・顧客データなどの移行サービスを最長2年ほど受ける
relations.text_en: Spun off from FedEx in June 2026; receives transition services such as order creation and customer data for up to about two years

source.label: FedEx Freight 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: The Company will receive certain transition services from FedEx following the Spin-Off, including support functions, such as order creation, customer data management, clearance, data and analytics

relations.text: Wabashが10-Kで、トレーラーを納める大口顧客の混載(LTL)輸送会社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Wabash lists FedEx Freight among large LTL carrier customers for its trailers

source.label: Wabash 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: ▪ Less-Than-Truckload Carriers: Saia, Inc.; FedEx Freight, Inc; Old Dominion Freight Lines, Inc.; and R&L Carriers, Inc.

relations.text: Alpha Teknovaが10-Kで、製品の配送に使う会社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Alpha Teknova ships much of its products via FedEx Freight among others

source.label: Alpha Teknova 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We ship a significant portion of our products to our customers through independent package delivery companies, such as FedEx, UPS, and FedEx Freight.

relations.text: FedExが10-Kで、FedEx Freightの主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: FedEx names it a primary competitor of FedEx Freight

source.label: FedEx 10-K(2025年5月期)
source.quote: FedEx Freight's primary competitors are XPO, Inc., Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc., ABF Freight (an ArcBest company), SAIA, Inc., and TFI International Inc.
